title.fil: Sukatin at iulat ang presyon ng dugo — bahagi 1

purpose.fil: Suriin ang aparato at angkop na cuff. Humingi ng pahintulot at ihanda ang tao ayon sa aprubadong checklist. Sukatin at ulitin kung hinihingi ng protocol. Itala ang aktuwal na resulta, yunit, oras at konteksto. Ipaabot sa midwife ang resulta at anumang concern.
purpose.en: Given approved equipment, a fictional client, and a current measurement protocol, take, record, and communicate a BP reading within scope.

group_size.fil: Tatluhan: BHW, residente at tagamasid; magpalit ng papel.
group_size.en: Triads: BHW, resident and observer; rotate roles.

materials.fil: Kathang-isip na participant card
materials.en: Fictional participant card

materials.fil: Observer sheet at kasalukuyang lokal na gabay
materials.en: Observer sheet and current local guide

steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso: Hiningi ng midwife kay BHW Amira ang BP ng isang kasamang nagsasanay. May gamit siyang aparatus at blangkong record. Susunod siya sa kasalukuyang aprubadong pamamaraan habang inoobserbahan ng supervisor.
steps.en: Read the case: The midwife asks BHW Amira to measure a training partner's BP. She has a device and a blank record. A supervisor watches while she follows the current approved procedure.

steps.fil: Ipagawa ang unang desisyon bago ipakita ang paliwanag.
steps.en: Ask for the first decision before showing the explanation.

steps.fil: Ipakita o sabihin ang gawain: Suriin ang aparato at angkop na cuff. Humingi ng pahintulot at ihanda ang tao ayon sa aprubadong checklist. Sukatin at ulitin kung hinihingi ng protocol. Itala ang aktuwal na resulta, yunit, oras at konteksto. Ipaabot sa midwife ang resulta at anumang concern.
steps.en: Demonstrate or explain the task: Check the device and suitable cuff. Ask permission and prepare the person using the approved checklist. Measure and repeat if the protocol requires it. Record the actual reading, units, time and context. Tell the midwife the result and any concern.

steps.fil: Gamitin ang observer sheet, magbigay ng isang tiyak na pagwawasto at ulitin ang kritikal na hakbang.
steps.en: Use the observer sheet, give one specific correction and repeat the critical step.

debrief.fil: Aling bahagi ang nakumpirma sa lokal na gabay, at ano ang kailangang i-refer?
debrief.en: Which part was confirmed in the local guide, and what needs referral?

observe.fil: Nasunod ang bawat kritikal na hakbang sa aprubadong BP checklist; naitala ang aktuwal na resulta at naipasa ito sa midwife ayon sa protocol.
observe.en: Completed each critical step on the approved BP checklist; recorded the actual reading and handed it to the midwife under the protocol.

observe.fil: Manghula ng resulta o sabihing normal ito kahit hindi pa nasuri sa protocol.
observe.en: Guess the reading or call it normal before checking the protocol.

output.fil: Isang nakumpletong observer sheet bawat kalahok.
output.en: One completed observer sheet per learner.

alternative.fil: Kung walang tatluhan, ipagawa nang paisa-isa sa facilitator at itala ang parehong indicator.
alternative.en: If triads are unavailable, observe each learner individually against the same indicator.

worksheet.fil: Isulat ang ginawa, feedback ng observer at hakbang na uulitin.
worksheet.en: Write the action taken, observer feedback and step to retry.
